purpose: Deterministic offline demand sampling request fixture paired with the committed demand artifact and sampled weather family fixtures.

provenance.author: OpenAI Codex
provenance.origin: Synthetic current-library US2 request-contract fixture for paired weather-and-demand replay coverage.
provenance.generation_command: Replay the committed offline demand sampler against tests/fixtures/demand/fitted_demand_artifact_v1.json and tests/fixtures/weather/sampled_weather_family_case.json.
provenance.refresh_policy: Update only when the stable demand sampling request controls, shared paired-family seed contract, or supported artifact references intentionally change.

notes: Pairs the committed US1 demand artifact fixture with the committed US2 sampled weather family fixture so offline replay stays deterministic and reviewable.
Uses the same paired family seed as the referenced weather family because the first-release pairing contract requires exact shared seed lineage across both producers.
